title: Nearly 96% of 5th-graders at Little Canada Elementary completed reading section of 2024-25 MCA
text:
Nearly 96% of 5th-graders at Little Canada Elementary completed reading section of 2024-25 MCA
V. D. Gordon
The fifth grade at Little Canada Elementary registered the third highest rate of participation for the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA, as reported by the Minnesota Department of Education.
Out of 377 students who took this test section at Little Canada Elementary, 87 were part of the fifth-grade cohort.
Based on assessment standards, 29% of those fifth-grade students reached proficiency in reading.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are Minnesota’s statewide tests gauging student achievement against academic standards and supporting state and federal law requirements. Depending on grade level, assessments cover reading, math and science. Most students are assessed with the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may take the Alt MCA.
Statewide, the Minnesota MCA proficiency rates have not recovered to pre-pandemic levels, according to Minnesota's Report Card. Overall math proficiency fell by more than 7% compared with 2019, and reading proficiency is nearly 5% lower.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 97 | 13% |
| 4th | 104 | 26% |
| 5th | 87 | 29% |
| 6th | 89 | 37% |
This article uses information from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data is available here.
